tools.name: list_public_showcase_events
tools.title: List public showcase events
tools.description: List published wedding/event pages that opted into the public showcase. Returns event type, slug, couple/host names, event date and venue.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.title: Get event details
tools.description: Fetch the public details of a wedding/event page by its event_type (e.g. 'casamento', 'aniversario') and slug. Returns couple names, date, venue, story and public message.

event_type.description: Event type segment from the URL, e.g. 'casamento' or 'aniversario'.

slug.description: Unique event slug from the URL.
